snippet.title: Our Home - Old Hiccup
snippet.description:
The game my team and I are working on right now is called "Our Home.” If you like the design, please don't hesitate to pledge and help us continue working on it!
https://www.patreon.com/oldhiccup
https://www.oldhiccup.com/

PLOT

Our Home is an adult visual novel set in a small town called Pinepool, the main source of income and work for the small town is tourism and two large transport companies.

Our Home tells the story of a young man who has lived his whole life in the orphanage, knowing that his mother died in childbirth, and his father left even before he was born, and when he reaches adulthood, he leaves the orphanage and has some challenges until he can find the answers to all the questions surrounding your story.

Features:
- Minigames
- Interactive map
- Inventory
- High-Quality renders
 - More Later.


Jazzaddict’s Intro by Cosimo Fogg (201) | https://soundcloud.com/cosimo-fogg
Music promoted by https://www.free-stock-music.com
